name: Yield
overview: The Scriptures reveal that yielding is closely connected to the fruitfulness of one's life in response to God's word. Those who receive the word with understanding and openness, likened to seed sown on good ground, bring forth abundant fruit—sometimes a hundredfold, sixtyfold, or thirtyfold—as seen in the teachings of Jesus in Matthew 13 and Mark 4, as well as Luke 8. Proverbs 11:18 contrasts the deceitful labor of the wicked with the sure reward given to those who sow righteousness, emphasizing that true yield is the result of righteous living empowered by God's truth.
